title: Attitude Profile (Geographic Pointing)
text: Calculate shortest quaternion rotation, 10 inputs, 2 outputs, {Celestial target} sets Celestial body; {Output rotation from current to updated attitude}, {Output attitude} sets the output updated attitude, {Port coordinate frame} sets the coordinate frame for position, velocity, and attitude ports, {Pointing mode} sets the primary vector alignment pointing mode Point, {Allow pointing mode change during run}, {Primary alignment (body-frame)} sets the primary alignment vector, {Secondary alignment (body-frame)} sets the secondary alignment vector, {Constraint coordinate frame, CCF} sets the constraint coordinate frame, {Primary constraint (CCF)} sets the primary constraint and {Secondary constraint (CCF)} sets the secondary constraint. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Output rotation from current to updated attitude
Port coordinate frame
params.values: Coordinate frame for position, velocity, and attitude ports ICRF (default) | Fixed-frame

params.name: Pointing mode
params.values: Primary vector alignment pointing mode Point at nadir (default) | Point at celestial body | Point at LatLonAlt | Custom

params.name: Allow pointing mode change during run
params.values: Allow pointing mode change during run off (default) | on

params.name: Celestial target
params.values: Celestial body Sun (default) | Mercury | Venus | Moon | Mars | Jupiter | Saturn | Uranus | Neptune | Pluto | Solar system barycenter | Earth-Moon barycenter

params.name: Constraint coordinate frame, CCF
params.values: Constraint coordinate frame ICRF (default) | Fixed-frame | LVLH | NED | Body-fixed
